title: Den
wikitext:
[[Image:TheDen.jpg|thumb|The Den]]
'''The Den''' is the base of operations in the [[Valley of Trials]], and is the starting camp for young [[troll]] and [[orc]] adventurers. It is in the small southwest corner of [[Durotar]]. This is where nearly all the Valley of Trials quests are obtained. It contains basic class trainers and vendors, but no profession trainers.
